## Verification

List actual commands/results and any unchecked areas. For model changes, include
independent feasibility/cost checks and solver status. CI environment checks alone
do not establish model correctness.

## Scope and review

- [ ] Relevant issue acceptance criteria are met or remaining work is identified.
- [ ] No original course documents, private data, credentials, or license files are included.
- [ ] Affected instructions and substantive AI-use notes are updated.
- [ ] Dependency changes include the lock and both generated requirements exports.
- [ ] An eligible reviewer who did no implementation will review the current head.

JoshKozy reviews are disclosed AI review. The reviewer never implements fixes.
